[Operations research, statistics, and simulation, delivered as tools people use.]{.jd-hero-lede}

U.S. Army **FA49 Operations Research and Systems Analysis** officer. I build models of
messy operational problems and ship them as software the people making the decision use:
predictive models on operational data, combat simulation, and decision-support tools.
